observations: A vintage-style sewing machine is mounted on a wooden table with a metal frame and a foot pedal.
The machine has a cream-colored body with visible wear, including chipped paint and scratches.
The table is dark red, with a yellow decorative strip along the front edge.
The foot pedal is metal with a grid design and has a label that appears to say 'SWOOPER' or similar, though it is partially obscured.
The machine has a large handwheel on the right side and a smaller knob on the left, typical of older sewing machines.
The background shows an outdoor setting with dirt ground, a sign for 'QUICK CHARGE', and some tires in the background.
The machine is not powered on; no motion or sound is visible in any photo.

claims.evidence: Photos 0-3 show visible wear, chipped paint, and scratches on the machine's body, indicating it is not in perfect condition.

risks.risk: The machine may not function properly or may be missing parts (e.g., needle, presser foot, bobbin case).
risks.proof: A close-up video or photo showing the machine in operation, with the needle moving and the presser foot engaged, and a full view of all components including the bobbin case and needle assembly.

risks.risk: The foot pedal may be damaged or non-functional.
risks.proof: A video showing the foot pedal being pressed and the machine responding with the handwheel turning.

risks.risk: The machine may have internal mechanical issues (e.g., rust, worn gears).
risks.proof: A close-up photo or video of the internal gears and mechanisms, especially around the handwheel and needle bar.

proof_requests: Close-up of the dial or plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the machine in operation, showing the needle moving and the handwheel turning.
Close-up photo or video of the foot pedal being pressed and the machine responding.
Close-up photo of the internal gears and mechanisms.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
